turnos.mensaje: How long does standard shipping usually take?

Standard shipping usually takes 2 to 4 business days. Express shipping takes 1 to 2 business days. Free shipping applies to orders of $75 or more. Please note that Nerds Store does not offer international shipping. If you have any other questions, feel free to ask.
Thanks! And is there a cutoff time for same-day processing if I want to order today?

I'm sorry, but the knowledge base doesn't include a same-day processing cutoff time. It only lists business hours: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM. For details on processing times, you can contact support@nerdsstore.example.
Got it, thanks for clarifying. What about returns? If I end up not liking something, how long do I have to send it back?
Standard items can be returned within 15 days. Damaged products must be reported within 7 days of delivery. Clearance items and opened headphones are not returnable.
Thanks, that's helpful! Quick follow-up: if I get a damaged item, is there a specific way I should report it, or do I just contact support@nerdsstore.example?

The knowledge base doesn't specify a particular reporting method for damaged items. It only states that damaged products must be reported within 7 days of delivery. You can contact support@nerdsstore.example, which is the store's listed support email.
Okay, last thing, thanks so much for all the help! Do you know if the store accepts returns in person, or does everything have to be shipped back?

The knowledge base doesn't include information about in-person returns, so I can't confirm whether that's available. It doesn't describe a return shipping method either. For details, you can contact support@nerdsstore.example. You're welcome, and I'm glad I could help.
Thanks again, that's all I needed. Have a great day!
You're welcome! Have a great day, and feel free to reach out anytime.
